**Average Home Price in California – Quick Snapshot**

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| **Median Listing Price (CA)** | ≈ $750 000–$800 000 (as of Q‑1 2025) |
| **Mean Sale Price (CA)** | ≈ $850 000–$900 000 (based on MLS & county records) |
| **Price per Square Foot** | ≈ $400–$450/ft² |

> *Note:* These figures come from aggregated public MLS data, Zillow’s “Home Value Index,” and state property tax assessments. Prices vary dramatically between coastal metros (San Francisco Bay Area, Los Angeles County), inland regions (Central Valley), and rural areas. For example:
>
> - San Francisco/Bay Area: Median ~ $1.8M  
> - Orange County / LA Metro: Median ~ $950K  
> - Sacramento / Central Valley: Median ~ $550K
